blocks.html: Notable property developer, Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) recently unveiled Gateway Regency STUDIOS. This development under the Robinsons Communities brand is affordably priced, well-located and optimum-sized home making it ideal for the hard-working urban professionals looking for a stable starting point to build their dreams and grow their passions. Located within the Gateway Regency Complex in Pioneer, Mandaluyong City, this development reforms the traditional studio units creating sufficient space and home solidity for the on-the-go millennial. Raising their glasses to celebrate this momentous event are (From L to R) Robinsons Communities Head of Sales, Mr. Ferdinand Adriano; RLC President and CEO Mr. Frederick D. Go; RLC Ambassadress Ms. Maja Salvador; RLC EVP Mr. Faraday D. Go and SVP BUGM, Robinsons Residential Division, Arch. Henry L. Yap.
Cheers to Robinsons Land Corporation and the success of this innovative development!
To know more about Robinsons Communities and its developments, call (02) 248-5888 or visit http://www.robinsonscommunities.com.
